title: Tools 3x3
description: This project adds two special tools wich are a Pickaxe and a shovel that you can use for server wich will mine a 3x3 area.
body:
# Tools3x3

Tools3x3 is a lightweight Bukkit/Paper plugin for Minecraft Java 1.21.1 that adds powerful custom Netherite tools with 3x3 mining abilities.

This plugin adds a special Netherite Pickaxe and a special Netherite Shovel, both enchanted with Efficiency VII. The Netherite Pickaxe can mine valid pickaxe blocks in a 3x3 area, while the Netherite Shovel can dig valid shovel blocks in a 3x3 area.

The tools are designed to be useful without being destructive. They will not break Bedrock, barriers, or command blocks. The pickaxe only affects blocks that a pickaxe should mine, and the shovel only affects blocks that a shovel should dig.

## Features

* Custom Netherite Pickaxe with 3x3 mining
* Custom Netherite Shovel with 3x3 digging
* Efficiency VII on both tools
* Only breaks blocks valid for each tool type
* Does not break Bedrock
* Does not break barriers
* Does not break command blocks
* Simple command system
* Lightweight and easy to use
* Made for Minecraft Java 1.21.1
* Compatible with Bukkit/Paper servers

## Commands

`/tool3x3 pickaxe`
Gives the player the special 3x3 Netherite Pickaxe.

`/tool3x3 pico`
Gives the player the special 3x3 Netherite Pickaxe using the Spanish command option.

`/tool3x3 shovel`
Gives the player the special 3x3 Netherite Shovel.

`/tool3x3 pala`
Gives the player the special 3x3 Netherite Shovel using the Spanish command option.

## Permission

`tools3x3.give`

Players need this permission to use the `/tool3x3` command. By default, only operators can use it.

## How it works

When a player breaks a block with one of the special tools, the plugin checks the tool type and the block type. If the block is valid for that tool, the plugin breaks nearby blocks in a 3x3 area.

The pickaxe only breaks blocks tagged as mineable with a pickaxe.
The shovel only breaks blocks tagged as mineable with a shovel.

Protected blocks like Bedrock, barriers, and command blocks are ignored.

## Installation

1. Download the plugin `.jar` file.
2. Place it inside your server’s `plugins` folder.
3. Restart the server.
4. Use `/tool3x3 pickaxe` or `/tool3x3 shovel` in-game.

## Version

Minecraft Java 1.21.1
Bukkit/Paper compatible
